title: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses Iowa
description: Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses is an investment to help entrepreneurs create jobs and economic opportunity by providing greater access to education, capital and business support services. To date, more than 9,100 business owners have graduated from the program across all 50 states in the US, Puerto Rico and Washington, D.C. Meet our newest alumni in Iowa: https://www.goldmansachs.com/citizenship/10000-small-businesses/US/profiles/index.html

asr.full_text: We haven't always been strong financially. When you're a small business owner or an entrepreneur, you get wrapped up in the business. It's nerve-wracking sometimes. I knew nothing at this point. Business ownership is a tough deal. It is just tough. Goldman Sachs' 10,000 Small Businesses Program just nailed it. The whole idea is to make your business grow. There I was in a room full of 36 other me's. Now I can chat with you guys and kind of lay it all out there. Going there and sitting in those classes and doing that homework. We're just more strategic now about how we go and expand. From cash flow to programs, they touched on your whole self. You really get in depth into the business. That is what is going to keep this business around. It's what's gotten me where I am today. By the end of it, I knew the route I needed to take my business. We've created four new positions. We've already expanded to two new cities. We'll dominate this state in two years. I never thought a million years we would.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it profiles Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses in Iowa, a business-support program whose participants take classes, do homework, and develop strategies for expansion. The business and workshop visuals are consistent with those profiles, and the reported jobs and expansion are participant outcomes rather than a solicitation to viewers.
